subject: [PATCH 24/60] mm/madvise: restrict reclaim advice to common memory

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series restricts the MADV_COLD, MADV_PAGEOUT, and MADV_FREE operations to common memory by converting ZONE_DEVICE checks in the mm/madvise.c file to use folio_is_common_memory(). This change aims to prevent these operations from being performed on non-common memory nodes.
